questions.q: How many mummified fingers hold Sukuna's power?
questions.why: Sukuna's power was sealed in 20 fingers scattered around the world.

questions.q: Who swallows one of Sukuna's fingers and becomes his vessel?
questions.why: Yuji eats a finger at Sugisawa High School.

questions.q: What title is Sukuna known by?
questions.why: He is the King of Curses.

questions.q: What is Sukuna's Domain Expansion called?
questions.why: The Malevolent Shrine uses Cleave and Dismantle.

questions.q: In which Japanese historical era was Sukuna the strongest sorcerer?
questions.why: He was a Heian-era sorcerer, over a thousand years ago.

questions.q: Which company produces the Jujutsu Kaisen TV anime?
questions.why: MAPPA's TV anime premiered on October 3, 2020.

questions.q: In what year did the Jujutsu Kaisen manga begin serialization?
questions.why: The manga began on March 5, 2018, after a 2017 prequel.

questions.q: Which ancient chronicle describes Ryomen-sukuna as two-faced with four arms?
questions.why: The Nihon Shoki describes a figure named Ryomen-sukuna.

questions.q: Who voices Sukuna in the English dub of the anime?
questions.why: Ray Chase gives the King of Curses his English voice.

questions.q: In which magazine did Akutami's 2017 prequel run?
questions.why: The four-chapter prequel Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School ran in Jump Giga in 2017.
